name: Notification Center
author: Jankees van Woezik
description: Every notification you were sent, kept, and readable again

barWidget.description: Every notification you were sent, kept, and readable again

schema.label: Keep at most
schema.description: Notifications. A ceiling on the archive regardless of age, so a chatty week cannot grow it without limit. Roughly a kilobyte each, plus whatever icons come with them.

schema.label: Clicking a notification
schema.description: Auto opens the picture a notification pointed at, a camera frame or a screenshot, and otherwise focuses the app that sent it. It never runs the command the notification arrived with: that command is chosen by whoever sent the notification, and a stored one is an attacker's command waiting for a click. Focus the app skips the file as well, and Nothing makes the list read-only.

schema.label: Show the message text
schema.description: Off leaves the sender and the subject line only, which is the version to run on a screen other people can see.

schema.label: Show pictures
schema.description: Notifications that are about a picture, a camera catching movement or a screenshot that was just taken, show it in the panel. Off keeps the text and leaves the picture where it was; the archive stops keeping copies of new ones as well.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Anything wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.
